name: Niuke Scan
description: Niuke Scan is a single-column landing-page theme for small warehouse docks using the N1 handheld scanner and Count Sheet app. A full-bleed documentary photograph of a scanner over an open carton opens the page under a tracked two-line headline, with a floating count chip and a white info bar. It continues with the missed-count message, a pinned three-stop dimmed photo stage with a dotted rail, ellipse photographs cut by the viewport edge with navy pills, a flat blue spec band with dotted rows, a price table, a parallax dock band with three stories, an FAQ and one repeated trial call. Inter Tight for headings, Albert Sans for reading. WCAG AA colours.
